Q00317_CatchTheWind/30361-07.html.text: Rizraell: Thank you. This blue jewel that quivers at the tip of my fingers is indeed a Wind Shard. I will compensate you according to how many you brought. Thank you for your trouble. Would you like to end the Contract? Or would you like to continue collecting?

links.text: Say you will end the Contract

Q00317_CatchTheWind/30361-05.html.text: Rizraell: Do you remember our Contract? If you find Wind Shards from lireins , the vengeful spirits of the wind, I will compensate you according to how many you bring me. They say there are many lirein in the Neutral Zone. Ask Sentinel Rayen about how to get there.

links.text: Say you will end the Contract

Q00317_CatchTheWind/30361-08.html.text: Rizraell: Thank you. I am much indebted to you even during the short time our fates were bound by Contract. May Eva's blessing be with you.

Q00317_CatchTheWind/30361-09.html.text: Rizraell: The Wind Shard that you collect will protect our forest from the poisons blowing from the Sea of Spores and give hope to the sailors that are stranded in the ocean. Well then, please continue to perform your services.
